name: Pluto
defines: Where you are remade — what you have power over and what has power over you. Pluto takes between twelve and thirty years to cross a sign, so this describes a whole cohort; the house it falls in shows where the pressure lands in your own life.

aries.definition: A cohort that transforms through raw self-assertion. What is being torn down and rebuilt is the idea of the individual will.
aries.showsUp: You do not accept being acted upon, and you can be uncompromising to the point of damage when your autonomy is threatened.

taurus.definition: A cohort that transforms what value means. What is being torn down and rebuilt is money, ownership and our relationship with the earth.
taurus.showsUp: You are deeply attached to what is yours, and your changes of direction are rare, slow and total.

gemini.definition: A cohort that transforms how truth circulates. What is being torn down and rebuilt is information, media and language itself.
gemini.showsUp: You understand that words are power, and you can be relentless in argument in a way you do not always notice.

cancer.definition: A cohort that transforms the family. What is being torn down and rebuilt is home, ancestry and national belonging.
cancer.showsUp: You carry inherited family intensity, and your deepest changes come through what happens with the people you came from.

leo.definition: A cohort that transforms the self. What is being torn down and rebuilt is individuality, authority and the right to shine.
leo.showsUp: You need to be the author of your own life, and you feel any attempt to diminish you as a threat rather than a slight.

virgo.definition: A cohort that transforms work and the body. What is being torn down and rebuilt is health, labour and the systems that maintain daily life.
virgo.showsUp: You are compelled to fix and improve, and you can be self-critical in a way that corrodes rather than refines.

libra.definition: A cohort that transforms relationship and justice. What is being torn down and rebuilt is marriage, fairness and the law.
libra.showsUp: Your relationships change you profoundly, and you can find yourself in power struggles disguised as negotiations.

scorpio.definition: A cohort that transforms what is hidden. Pluto rules this sign, so the work is the exposure itself — of sexuality, death, money and power.
scorpio.showsUp: You are drawn to the truth beneath the surface, you keep your own depths private, and you rebuild yourself entirely more than once.

sagittarius.definition: A cohort that transforms belief. What is being torn down and rebuilt is religion, ideology and the stories cultures tell themselves.
sagittarius.showsUp: You cannot leave a conviction unexamined, and you can hold a belief with an intensity that shades into zeal.

capricorn.definition: A cohort that transforms institutions. What is being torn down and rebuilt is government, business and structural authority.
capricorn.showsUp: You are ambitious in a serious, long-range way, and you understand how power actually operates rather than how it is described.

aquarius.definition: A cohort that transforms the collective. What is being torn down and rebuilt is community, technology and who holds shared power.
aquarius.showsUp: You are compelled by the idea of a fairer system, and you can be absolute about a principle in a way that costs you personally.

pisces.definition: A cohort that transforms the imagination. What is being torn down and rebuilt is faith, art and the collective unconscious.
pisces.showsUp: You are pulled towards what dissolves the self, and you undergo your deepest changes quietly and largely unobserved.
